title: Analysis Module Contract
description: Design contract for modules/analysis. Analysis is the only module allowed to render a judgment: it turns Vision's captured evidence into journey scores, innovation scores, AI-capability findings, and answers to the 5 mandatory questions from CLAUDE.md. This is the codified form of the scoring an agent currently does by hand — it is not implemented yet. Output shape intentionally mirrors the company entry shape already used in Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json and per-company metadata.json, so a future writer needs no translation layer.

AnalysisInput.description: What the orchestrator hands Analysis once Vision has finished a run.

run_id.description: Must match the run_id Vision produced.

vision_output.description: Analysis consumes Vision's output type directly — no separate transport format.

matrix_context.description: Optional. Prior state from Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json, supplied so Analysis can note deltas against the company's previous run (re-benchmarks) rather than scoring in a vacuum.

mandatory_questions_required.description: Optional. When true (default), Analysis must populate mandatory_questions in its output — every benchmark answers all 5 per CLAUDE.md.

AnalysisOutput.description: Scored, judged findings for one company — the input Pattern and Reports both build on.

journey_scores.description: Keyed by JourneyStepId. Shape matches Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's companies[slug].journey_scores.

applicable.description: False when this step doesn't exist for the product (e.g. an OTA has no check-in step).

score.description: Required when applicable is true; must be null when applicable is false.

key_finding.description: Optional one-line summary shown on the Dashboard's Overview tab.

innovation_scores.description: The 5 dimensions plus their mean. Matches companies[slug].innovation_scores.

overall.description: Mean of the 5 dimensions — computed, not independently judged.

ai_capabilities.description: Keyed by capability id from Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's schema.ai_capabilities (e.g. 'conversational_search', 'ai_memory').

score.description: Optional — null when status is absent.

label.description: Short display label, e.g. '✅ Full NLP' or '❌'.

ux_patterns.description: Keyed by pattern id from Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's schema.ux_patterns.

quality.description: Optional — only meaningful when present is true.

mandatory_questions.description: Optional (see input.mandatory_questions_required), but present on every complete benchmark. The 5 questions from CLAUDE.md, answered for this company.
